name: b05 — cumulative credit shares exhaust a line of 100 over qty 3
workings: F = 100 over n = 3, credited one unit at a time. Cumulative: cum(1) = divHalfUp(100, 3) = floor((200 + 3) / 6) = floor(33.83) = 33; cum(2) = divHalfUp(200, 3) = floor((400 + 3) / 6) = floor(67.17) = 67; cum(3) = divHalfUp(300, 3) = 100. Shares are the differences: 33, 67 - 33 = 34, 100 - 67 = 33 — summing to 100 exactly, the remainder landing on the last step. The naive per-refund share divHalfUp(100 x 1, 3) = 33 three times sums to 99 and leaks a paise into nobody's pocket (mutant M-B05, self-review item 2).
